overview.short: The Millennium City of NCR — famous for Cyber Hub dining, luxury golf resorts, bird sanctuaries, and entertainment centers.
overview.description: Gurugram is modern India's corporate and entertainment hub. Beyond its soaring glass skyscrapers, Cyber Hub nightlife, and Michelin-worthy dining, Gurugram offers nature retreats like Sultanpur Bird Sanctuary, Aravali Biodiversity Park, and luxury golf resorts.

howToReach.roadNote: Nearest major city: New Delhi (25 km).
